instead.form: registration form — add the “Form” module and put the questions in it
instead.registration: own registration — the “Your registration” module (behind a personal link)
instead.card: participant card — questions in the “Form” module, consents in its settings
instead.roster: participant list — the form's registrations in the Workshop
instead.checklist: list of things to do — the “Steps” module (behind a personal link)
instead.topics: topics to talk about — the “Conversation” module
instead.meme: memes — not yet in the new system

legacy.hidden: “{label}” was hidden — moved over, check whether it should be visible.

transition.scroll: Scroll — comes in from below, like a sheet (default)
transition.flow: Flow — moves up with the scrolling and blends with the previous one
transition.fade: Crossfade — the previous one stays, this one appears on it
transition.cover: Cover — this one slides over the previous one, which stays and dims
transition.reveal: Reveal — the previous one moves up and reveals this one
transition.zoom: Zoom — the previous one grows and vanishes, this one emerges from the depth
transition.side: From the side — this one comes in from the right, the previous one moves left
transition.dissolve: Dissolve — the previous one fades, blurs and sinks, this one sharpens while rising (like the Cogita show)

editor.coverLater: Title slide (appears when the page has a title or text)
editor.coverHint: The page's title and text — on the first slide. Here its background.
editor.empty: There is no slide yet. Add the first one below.
editor.onStage: On the stage — moves between slides
editor.beside: Beside another module, on its slide
editor.onStageTag: · on the stage, moves between slides
editor.label: Name in the slide menu
editor.labelHint: Empty: the module's heading. A link in a text “#{{word}}” leads to this slide.
editor.stageNote: Moves between slides — has no slide of its own; it stands above all of them and, when the slide changes, moves to its place on the next one (a logo, a “Sign up” button, a counter, a quote).
editor.besideNote: Beside another module — on its slide, in one row (an image, an animation beside a text); on a phone above or below it.
editor.previewHint: Preview — scroll in the frame, click the slide names. This is what a visitor will see (without saving).

set.transition: How this slide replaces the previous one
set.firstSlide: This is the first slide — you'll see the transition only on the next ones.
set.transitionHint: The transition follows the scrolling: dragged slowly — it happens slowly, pulled back — it goes back. With “reduce motion” set in the system it becomes a crossfade.
set.colorsHint: This slide's own colours (empty — like the page). Between slides the colours change smoothly, the bar with slide names too.
set.bare: Without a frame (logo, image, plain text)
set.stageHint: The place on each slide: the module's centre in percent of the stage (x — from the left, y — from the top), the width in percent (larger on a phone). A slide without its own place — the module flows through it between the neighbouring ones.
set.tallOwn: A different place on a screen taller than wide
set.layoutHint: Where the slide's content stands on the stage (the stage width — in “The whole show”). Empty — in the centre, a comfortable text width.
set.phoneTall: On a phone (a screen taller than wide)
set.themeAutoHint: The page's colours — light or dark, like the visitor's device.

nav.dots: Dots on the right (like the Cogita show)

layer.noTitleSlide: No title slide — the first module is the first screen (the page title stays in the browser tab and at the bottom)
layer.stageWidthHint: The places of modules moving between slides and the slide layout count within this width — on a wide screen the picture stays together (80 rem — like the Cogita show).
layer.backdropHint: It stands behind all slides and under their own backgrounds. When it is there, the slides move over it transparent, and their own backgrounds travel and vanish with them — the shared background (colours, threads, waves, haze) stays.
layer.defaultHint: Default background: a gradient from the background colour and the slide name as a large, pale text — it adapts to the theme.
layer.layersHint: Layers as on the screen: at the top of the list what lies on top, at the bottom what lies deepest. Speed 0 — stands still, 1 — moves with the content.
layer.upAria: Layer up — closer to the top
layer.travelHint: The text travels from bottom to top; 1 = the full screen height.
layer.lines: Lines of the text (at most three)
